description: Developing a large-scale dataset of flood fatalities for territories in the Euro-Mediterranean region, FFEM-DB is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Katerina Papagiannaki et al. This data paper describes the multinational Database of Flood Fatalities from the Euro-Mediterranean region FFEM-DB that hosts data of 2,875 flood fatalities from 12 territories (nine of which represent entire countries) in Europe and the broader Mediterranean region from 1980 to 2020. Coverage: continental; published in 2022. Formats: Image. The data are held in 4TU.ResearchData and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
